first_rules: html body #side-bar:hover, html body #side-bar:focus-within { background-color: rgb(var(--sidebar-bg-color)) !important; }

matching_side_rules.text: #side-bar .side-block.media a img { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 0 rgba(var(--swatch-alternate-color), 0)); transition: filter 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), -webkit-filter 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); }
#side-bar .side-block.media a:hover img, #side-bar .side-block.media a:active img { filter: drop-shadow(0.1875rem 0.1875rem 0 rgb(var(--swatch-alternate-color))); }

option_candidates.rationale: Preserve the dark sidebar palette while the JP rev3 toggle-sidebar opens it by pointer hover or keyboard focus; scope credit-preview sizing away from native rating controls, which otherwise cause Sigma-10 narrow/mobile overflow.
